name_ja: V2 TOKYO（ブイツー トーキョー）
address_en: TOWER OF VABEL 1F/B1F, 7-13-7 Roppongi, Minato-ku, Tokyo 106-0032
address_ja: 〒106-0032 東京都港区六本木7-13-7 TOWER OF VABEL 1F / B1F
entry_fee: Weekend men: JPY 4,000 with 2 drink tickets, or JPY 10,000 with 10 tickets; women free (official site, read 2026-10-10). Halloween weekend 30-31 Oct only: men JPY 5,000. VIP early plan Fri/Sat JPY 55,000 for up to 4, 21:00-01:00.
dress_code: Official: dress up; entry may be refused if attire does not fit the dress code (ドレスアップしてお越しください).
door_policy: Photo ID required for everyone (passport for a foreigner). Official site states no rule against solo men or foreigners; a 2026 English-site option exists and international-meetup events are held there. Weekend queues reported in reviews.
music: EDM / open-format club hits, guest DJs (DVBBS booked 3 Dec 2026). October 2026 = Halloween party month (2-31 Oct).
crowd: Japanese reviews: grown-up suited crowd, people with money, occasional celebrities. Signal from small-sample reviews, not verified.
jp_review_quotes: 「スーツで来るイケイケな大人の比率が高い」(ranking.net)
「ある程度お金に余裕がある人向けのクラブ」(ranking.net, summarised)
fit_reason: The most 'adult money' mainstream club in Roppongi per Japanese reviews; dress-up policy; open until 05:00 tonight; card payment.
caveats: October is Halloween month, so expect costumes and a younger crowd mix on weekends. A big-room club with VIP-table culture: on the floor, a solo man pays entry and stands. Crowd quotes come from a low-vote ranking site.

name_ja: THE TOKYO CLUB（ザ トウキョウ クラブ）
category: luxury bar lounge with DJ bar floor
address_en: B1F, 4-1-1 Nishi-Azabu, Minato-ku, Tokyo 106-0031 (under Nishi-Azabu crossing)
hours_saturday: 20:00-04:00 (L.O. 03:30), open daily, per official site 2026. Time Out JP lists 20:00-28:00.
entry_fee: Not published (no cover charge found). Bar/food pricing not checked.
dress_code: Not published. Luxury-lounge setting, so smart is the safe choice (my inference).
door_policy: Not published. ECN Hospitality runs 'global guest service' (Time Out JP), so it is foreign-friendly in intent. Reservations via the official site. Walk-in not verified: call 03-6427-4276.
music: DJ bar floor on a British 'Void' sound system (official site). Earlier press: German, Italian and French speakers by zone.
crowd: Time Out JP: 「最先端の大人の遊び場」(cutting-edge adult playground). No Japanese user reviews of the crowd found in this pass.
jp_review_quotes: 「西麻布交差点の地下に、ラグジュアリーバーラウンジ」(Time Out Tokyo JP, 2025-03-31)
「最先端の大人の遊び場」(Time Out Tokyo JP)
fit_reason: Newest posh Nishi-Azabu late-night DJ lounge (opened March 2025): an adult bar-lounge format rather than a dance club, and it suits a 43-year-old better than a big-room club.
caveats: New venue with little review history. Crowd, prices and walk-in policy are unverified, so call before going. Note the rename: 'THE TOKYO' (FASHIONSNAP, Jan 2025) is now 'THE TOKYO CLUB'. Five private rooms (4-30 people) suggest a group or VIP focus.
photo_credit: Time Out Tokyo JP listing image (media.timeout.com/images/106441442)

address_ja: 〒106-0032 東京都港区六本木6-1-3 六門ビル6F
gmaps_query: マハラジャ六本木 六本木6-1-3
hours_saturday: 19:00-05:00. Tonight 10 Oct: 14:00-19:00 '錦糸町伝説', then 19:00 'GLOBAL MIX' (official schedule).
entry_fee: Sat men JPY 3,500 with 1 drink (happy hour 19:00-21:00: JPY 2,000 with 1 drink); women JPY 2,500 (official /charge/).
dress_code: Official: no sandals, running sneakers, track suits, sweats, tank tops, shorts, work clothes, dirty or otherwise rough clothing, or exposed tattoos. Final call is at staff discretion.
door_policy: No published rule against solo men or foreigners. Standing capacity 250. Phone 03-6804-1798.
music: Disco plus current club hits (CLUB&DISCO mix). Saturday = 'GLOBAL MIX'.
crowd: Bubble-era MAHARAJA brand revived. Pitched in Japanese media as a place anyone can enjoy even without club experience, and as a stop after work. No hard crowd-age data, but it is the venue most oriented to 30s-50s Japanese.
jp_review_quotes: 「クラブやディスコに行ったことがなくても、誰もが安心して楽しめる」(icotto/smartlog intro, 2015, summarised by search)
fit_reason: The best age fit for a 43-year-old among Roppongi clubs: a disco heritage brand, an early 19:00 start, a low fixed cover and a published dress code.
caveats: More nostalgic/fun than 'posh 港区女子'. The crowd-age claim is an inference from the format, not a sourced statistic. The Japanese intro quote is from 2015.
